name: puretokens-skill
description: Installable Pure Tokens skills and skill management tooling.

scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-skills.mjs && node scripts/sync-skill-model-selection.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-readme-media-catalog.mjs --check
scripts.bundle:claude: node bin/puretokens-skill.js bundle puretokens_balance --format claude-desktop --out dist/puretokens_balance-0.8.0.zip --force && node bin/puretokens-skill.js bundle puretokens_image --format claude-desktop --out dist/puretokens_image-0.8.0.zip --force && node bin/puretokens-skill.js bundle puretokens_video --format claude-desktop --out dist/puretokens_video-0.8.0.zip --force
